Can we train the model outside the notebook and use notebook/submission zip for submission?
Can we use closed source models like gpt to create a synthetic data and fine-tune the nemotron model?

[message_id=3430969 author=Van Dong Tran first=False]
You can only submit the zip file of lora adapter, not necessary a notebook. The evaluation metric will check and you only your submission zip file. For dataset, as i read and know, you can use what ever you want as long as it's legal
